extension.summary: ABeCedni KAtalog SErialu a FIlmu - alphabetical catalog of movies and series
ABeCedni KAtalog SErialu a FIlmu - abecedni katalog filmu a serialu
extension.description: ABCKASEFI browses a catalog of movies and series by letter A-Z, by TMDB lists (top rated, popular, trending) and by search, with Czech, Slovak or English titles. The catalog is a small service you run yourself (abckasefi-catalog); this add-on only lists titles and hands the playback over to the Nokturno add-on, which has to be installed and set up separately. Watched marks and resume points are Kodi's own. The add-on does not host, index or distribute any content. Set the catalog address and token in the add-on settings or scan the QR code with your phone.

ABCKASEFI prochazi katalog filmu a serialu podle pismen A-Z, podle seznamu TMDB (nejlepe hodnocene, popularni, trend) a hledanim, s ceskymi, slovenskymi nebo anglickymi nazvy. Katalog je mala sluzba, kterou si provozujes sam (abckasefi-catalog); tento doplnek jen vypisuje tituly a prehravani preda doplnku Nokturno, ktery musi byt nainstalovany a nastaveny zvlast. Zhlednuto a pokracovani ve sledovani jsou nativni funkce Kodi. Doplnek zadny obsah nehostuje, neindexuje ani nesiri. Adresu katalogu a token nastavis v nastaveni doplnku nebo naskenovanim QR kodu telefonem.
extension.disclaimer: This add-on provides no content. What you play through Nokturno is your own responsibility.
Doplnek neposkytuje zadny obsah. Za to, co prehravas pres Nokturno, odpovidas ty.
